comment: Snippets in the launcher's Snippets… (the ⌘ menu, the CMD menu), per system: Copy puts the text on the clipboard. Fetched from the repository's main branch, so a new one reaches every launcher.

snippets.name: cc alias for Claude Code
snippets.description: cc starts Claude Code, updated first, without permission prompts
snippets.text:
(
f="$HOME/.config/mylinux/my-aliases.sh"; mkdir -p "${f%/*}"; touch "$f"
sed -i '/^alias cc=/d' "$f"
echo "alias cc='claude update && claude --dangerously-skip-permissions'" >> "$f"
for rc in "$HOME/.bashrc" "$HOME/.profile"; do [ -f "$rc" ] && ! grep -qF .config/mylinux/my-aliases.sh "$rc" && echo '[ -f "$HOME/.config/mylinux/my-aliases.sh" ] && . "$HOME/.config/mylinux/my-aliases.sh"' >> "$rc"; done
echo "cc is ready in new terminals (or now: . ~/.config/mylinux/my-aliases.sh)"
)

snippets.name: Alias for a Claude subscription
snippets.description: An alias (ccwork, …) that starts Claude Code with that subscription's token; the status line shows its name
snippets.text:
(
printf 'Alias for this subscription (one word, e.g. ccwork): '; read -r name </dev/tty
printf 'Its name in the status line (e.g. viktor_gmail): '; read -r account </dev/tty
printf 'Its Claude Code token, from claude setup-token (hidden): '; stty -echo </dev/tty; read -r token </dev/tty; stty echo </dev/tty; echo
case "$name" in ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9_-]*) echo "The alias is one word: letters, digits, _ -"; exit 1 ;; esac
case "$token" in ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9_-]*) echo "That is not a token (sk-ant-oat01-...)"; exit 1 ;; esac
account=$(printf %s "$account" | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9._@-')
d="$HOME/.config/mylinux/claude-accounts"; mkdir -p "$d"; chmod 700 "$d"
( umask 077; printf "# Claude Code as %s (the alias %s)\nexport CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN='%s'\nexport MYLINUX_CLAUDE_ACCOUNT='%s'\n" "$account" "$name" "$token" "$account" > "$d/$name.env" )
f="$HOME/.config/mylinux/my-aliases.sh"; touch "$f"; sed -i "/^alias $name=/d" "$f"
printf "alias %s='( . \"\$HOME/.config/mylinux/claude-accounts/%s.env\" && unset ANTHROPIC_API_KEY && claude update && claude --dangerously-skip-permissions )'\n" "$name" "$name" >> "$f"
for rc in "$HOME/.bashrc" "$HOME/.profile"; do [ -f "$rc" ] && ! grep -qF .config/mylinux/my-aliases.sh "$rc" && echo '[ -f "$HOME/.config/mylinux/my-aliases.sh" ] && . "$HOME/.config/mylinux/my-aliases.sh"' >> "$rc"; done
echo "$name starts Claude Code as $account, in new terminals (or now: . ~/.config/mylinux/my-aliases.sh); myLinux Apps lists it under Claude Code"
)

snippets.name: cx alias for Codex
snippets.description: cx starts Codex without approvals or sandbox
snippets.text:
(
f="$HOME/.config/mylinux/my-aliases.sh"; mkdir -p "${f%/*}"; touch "$f"

snippets.name: Alias for a Codex subscription
snippets.description: An alias (cxwork, …) that starts Codex signed in to its own ChatGPT account (a CODEX_HOME of its own)
snippets.text:
(
printf 'Alias for this Codex account (one word, e.g. cxwork): '; read -r name </dev/tty
case "$name" in ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9_-]*) echo "The alias is one word: letters, digits, _ -"; exit 1 ;; esac
home="$HOME/.codex-$name"; mkdir -p "$home"; chmod 700 "$home"
[ -f "$HOME/.codex/config.toml" ] && [ ! -f "$home/config.toml" ] && cp "$HOME/.codex/config.toml" "$home/"
f="$HOME/.config/mylinux/my-aliases.sh"; mkdir -p "${f%/*}"; touch "$f"; sed -i "/^alias $name=/d" "$f"
printf "alias %s='CODEX_HOME=\"\$HOME/.codex-%s\" codex --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox'\n" "$name" "$name" >> "$f"
for rc in "$HOME/.bashrc" "$HOME/.profile"; do [ -f "$rc" ] && ! grep -qF .config/mylinux/my-aliases.sh "$rc" && echo '[ -f "$HOME/.config/mylinux/my-aliases.sh" ] && . "$HOME/.config/mylinux/my-aliases.sh"' >> "$rc"; done
echo "$name starts Codex with its own sign-in (~/.codex-$name): the first start asks you to sign in with that ChatGPT subscription"
)
